searchText: Are you planning to do bootlicking e.g. banning Tornadocash subdomain? gm, so when's the next shadow fork? https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/692062809701482577/1015195515811549295 (Next friday) Q: after the merge will txns also go to the POW fork mempool? Or does it have a different chain Id? Should be a question for them But afaik they aren't changing the chain id so it will confuse things by a lot if the dont change it then every POW txn would be valid on POS do they have a discord or something? IMO, the chain ID should change for the branch of the fork that is actually changing code. I have never liked that it was essentially a marketing contest to see who gets to keep the chain ID and ticker. I would be much happier if every network upgrade changed the chain ID and ticker, as I think that would make the system for more legitimate. The PoW fork is changing code in a number of ways. I assumed that would happen sometime *after* the merge? Seems like you would want to first split off by not merging, then start making changes, rather than making changes at the same time? No, from what I've seen so far, they plan to fork ahead of the merge (at a fixed block height) and will be doing things like locking various defi contracts, making EIP1559 base fee pay to the developers and I think a few other things. Any idea what block number? Or where one can find out. Not sure - they had a website somewhere I think but it's so hard to tell what's the "real" EthPOW and what's a scam. It all seems pretty scammy to be honest... I found *a* website a while back but didn't see anything on it about a pre-merge date. It seems quite silly to fork *before* the merge as you are going to be fighting ETH for hashpower. They are using our logo without permission it’s likely a scam site the code is wack
